data.exact_reserve_text: The updates have resulted in ultimate gross reserves of GBP 393.4m, GBP 113.8m net of reinsurance (31 December 2023 - GBP 264.5m gross, GBP 84.5m net of reinsurance) as at 31 December 2024. The casualty business group experienced deterioration to the prior year reserves as a result of construction defect claims in Florida. The syndicate has seen an increase in the frequency of lawsuits relating to issues on its Florida based contractors book arising from construction defects. Due to the continued adverse development seen during the year additional gross reserves of GBP 52.7m and GBP 52.3m net of reinsurance were recorded bringing the overall gross reserves for this class to GBP 132.0m (2023 - GBP 79.4m) and net reserves to GBP 131.3m (2023GBP 79.0m). As a result of the adverse prior year loss development arising from the Russia/Ukraine losses and the Artisans sub class, the 2021 year of account is in a cumulative loss as at 31 December 2024.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves, primarily driven by adverse development on Russian aviation exposures and Florida construction defect claims. The ultimate gross reserves for Russian aviation exposures increased by GBP 128.9m, while Florida construction defect claims led to an additional GBP 52.7m in gross reserves. These movements, alongside other smaller adjustments, resulted in a total gross prior year strengthening of GBP 190.59m. The 2021 year of account remains open due to the ongoing uncertainty surrounding the Russian aviation losses.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 18), as no single explicit gross prior year movement figure was found. The calculated total of GBP 190.59m aligns with the sum of specific strengthenings mentioned in the narrative for Russian aviation (GBP 128.9m gross) and Florida construction defects (GBP 52.7m gross), which total GBP 181.6m gross, with the difference likely due to other minor movements captured in the triangle.
